# Publication figures (generated by `workflows/paper/p97_paper_figures.py`; 300 dpi PNG + PDF)

Main text Fig01–Fig08, supplement FigS01–FigS06; captions in `../captions.md`; style in
`src/floodstate_eo/visualization/figstyle.py` (fixed palette: terrain #2a78d6, Sentinel-1 #eb6834, U-Net #4a3aa7, RF #1baf7a).
Figures that read bulk rasters (Fig01, Fig03, Fig05, Fig07) are rendered locally and committed; the others rebuild from the
committed tables (`p97 --tables-only`).
